hand_check.criteria: hand_category: the first category, in the order and with the meanings in src/eval/errors.py, that describes a real mistake, a difference that changes the answer; differences in how the SQL is written that give the same answer (a harmless extra join, an equivalent condition) do not count; format_only when the answer's rows and values are right and only their shape differs (extra, reordered or combined columns, rounding). Judged from the question, the hint and both queries, without the automatic category, with read-only queries of the data where a fact decides it. expert_questionable: true if the expert query itself does not answer the question as asked (counted, never re-scored).

designs_exploratory.note: exploratory, not pre-registered: format-only misses counted as right; one run per design; intervals are paired 95% bootstrap intervals over the ablation questions
